items.title: 公開トーク番組「吉Pラジオ/吉Pナイト」，台風接近に伴う悪天候や交通機関への影響を考慮し開催中止に

zh.title: 公开脱口秀“Kichi P Radio/Kichi P Night”因恶劣​​天气以及台风逼近对交通造成影响而取消

en.title: Public talk show "Kichi P Radio/Kichi P Night" canceled due to bad weather and impact on transportation due to approaching typhoon
en.summary: The talk shows "KichiP Radio" and "KichiP Night" scheduled to be held on September 21, 2026 at "404NotFound" at Shibuya Sakura Stage in Tokyo have been cancelled. zh.summary: 据透露，今天结束的“东京游戏展 2026”的参观总人数为 257,642 人。根据9月17日至20日四天的统计，与去年的263,101人相比，减少了5,459人。该活动原定举行五天，但因9月21日25号台风而取消。 2027年计划于9月16日至20日在幕张展览馆举办。

en.title: The total number of visitors over the four days of Tokyo Game Show 2026 was 257,642. Scheduled to be held at Makuhari Messe from September 16th to 20th in 2027 [TGS2026]
en.summary: It has been revealed that the total number of visitors to ``Tokyo Game Show 2026,'' which ended its real-life event today, was 257,642. Based on the four-day tally from September 17th to 20th, there was a decrease of 5,459 people compared to the previous year's 263,101 people. The event was originally scheduled to be held for five days, but was canceled due to Typhoon No. 25 on September 21st. In 2027, it is scheduled to be held at Makuhari Messe from September 16th to 20th.

zh.title: 全面重新平衡了 102 名英雄。 《King's Raid Reverse》经过精心重制，并提供完整的语音支持。专访获取IP的Masangsoft副总裁【TGS2026】

en.title: Fully rebalanced 102 heroes. ``King's Raid Reverse'' has been carefully reworked with full voice support. Interview with the vice president of Masangsoft who acquired the IP [TGS2026]
en.summary: Masangsoft has acquired the IP of the discontinued ``King's Raid,'' and is preparing to restart it as ``King's Raid Reverse.'' We asked Kwon Dong-hyuk, vice president of the company, who came to Japan for TGS2026, about the background of the acquisition and the details of the redesign.

en.title: Flydigi exhibits its latest game pad "APEX 6" series. Collaboration models with Rei Ayanami, Zenzero, etc. are also available [TGS2026]

This time we mainly checked the APEX6Pro, so we will introduce its features, including the differences from previous generation products.

items.title: “縛り”から創造された，そうだったかもしれない5つの時代。セガブースに出展された「STRANGER THAN HEAVEN」の見どころを，RGGスタジオのキーマンに聞いた［TGS2026］

zh.title: 可能因“束缚”而产生的五个时代。我们向RGG工作室的一位关键人物询问了世嘉展台上展出的《STRANGER THAN HEAVEN》的亮点[TGS2026]
zh.summary: 在“东京电玩展2026”的世嘉展台上，展出了RGG工作室推出的新作《STRANGERTHANHEAVEN》。 TGS2026 的 SEGA 展位将提供各种内容，包括能够在演示主机上快速进行战斗，我们向 RGG Studio 的一位关键人物询问了这些展品的目的以及他们在创作作品时所投入的承诺。

en.title: Five eras that may have been created from "binding". We asked a key person at RGG Studio about the highlights of "STRANGER THAN HEAVEN" exhibited at the Sega booth [TGS2026]
en.summary: At the Sega booth at "Tokyo Game Show 2026", the new work "STRANGERTHANHEAVEN" presented by RGG Studio is on display. items.title: 2匹のペットが，飼い主をロープ代わりにして大冒険！ 「It Takes Paws」は，プレイヤー2人の協力が必須だ［TGS2026］

zh.title: 两只宠物以主人为绳索，踏上大冒险！ “It Takes Paws”需要两名玩家的合作 [TGS2026]

en.title: Two pets go on a big adventure using their owners as ropes! “It Takes Paws” requires the cooperation of two players [TGS2026]
en.summary: A playable cooperative action game "ItTakesPaws" by AwooStudio is on display at the 2PGames booth at Tokyo Game Show 2026. This is a work that requires teamwork, with two players controlling a cat and a dog, using their limp owners like ropes to advance.

At the venue, a special box for this work will be on display, as well as merchandise for sale.

items.title: せっせとドーナツを作っていると異変が迫る!?「DONUT PANIC/ドーナッても冷静に」プレイレポート。無事に夜を越すためには……？［TGS2026］

zh.title: 当你忙着制作甜甜圈时，奇怪的事情出现了！？ 《DONUT PANIC》播放报道。为了平安度过这一夜……？ [TGS2026]
zh.summary: 在2026年东京游戏展的SELECTEDINDIE80展位上，居住在爱丁堡的个人开发者凯尔·班克斯(Kyle Banks)的新游戏《DONUTPANIC》正在展出。我一直在玩一款由真正热爱甜甜圈烹饪的开发者制作的独特恐怖游戏。

en.title: While you're busy making donuts, something strange approaches!? "DONUT PANIC" play report. In order to get through the night safely...? [TGS2026]
en.summary: At the SELECTEDINDIE80 booth at Tokyo Game Show 2026, a new game ``DONUTPANIC'' by Kyle Banks, an individual developer living in Edinburgh, is on display. I've been playing a unique horror game by a developer who truly loves donut cooking.

items.title: PS5/XBOX版の発売も控える「Euro Truck Simulator 2」。SCS Softwareにアジア展開を本格化する動きを聞いた［TGS2026］

zh.title: 《欧洲卡车模拟2》即将在PS5/XBOX上发售。我们听说 SCS Software 正在认真进军亚洲 [TGS2026]
zh.summary: SCSSoftware在TGS 2026的NeonNoroshi展位上展出。在玩《EuroTruckSimulator2》时，我们谈论了全面扩展到亚洲地区的原因、对消费者版本的mod支持以及控制器操作的细节。

en.title: "Euro Truck Simulator 2" is about to be released on PS5/XBOX. We heard about SCS Software's move to expand into Asia in earnest [TGS2026]
en.summary: SCSSoftware was exhibiting at the NeonNoroshi booth at TGS 2026. While playing ``EuroTruckSimulator2'', we talked about the reason for full-scale expansion into the Asian region, the mod support for the consumer version, and the details of the controller operation.

items.title: 「Cinderia」4Gamerステージで“2人協力モード”をお披露目。装備品の分配や決死の救助など，会話が生まれるマルチプレイ［TGS2026］
items.summary: 東京ゲームショウ2026の4Gamerブースで，MyACGStudioとNPCEntertainmentのPC向けローグライトアクションゲーム「Cinderia」のステージを開催した。本稿では，ここで新発表された「2人協力モード」の実機プレイをレポートする。

zh.title: 《灰姑娘》在4Gamer舞台上推出了“两人合作模式”。创造对话的多人游戏，例如分发装备和绝望救援 [TGS2026]
zh.summary: 在2026年东京电玩展的4Gamer展位上，MyACGStudio和NPC Entertainment的PC Roguelite动作游戏《灰姑娘》举行了舞台。在这篇文章中，我们将报道新公布的“2人合作模式”的实际玩法。

en.title: “Cinderia” unveiled “2-player cooperative mode” on 4Gamer stage. Multiplayer that creates conversation, such as distributing equipment and desperate rescues [TGS2026]
en.summary: At the 4Gamer booth at Tokyo Game Show 2026, a stage was held for MyACGStudio and NPC Entertainment's PC roguelite action game "Cinderia." In this article, we will report on the actual play of the newly announced "2-player cooperative mode".

items.title: 発売されたばかりの最新ゲームパッド「Xeno Pro」をLeadJoyブースでチェック。見覚えのあるアタッチメントとの再会も

zh.title: 看看LeadJoy展位上刚刚发布的最新游戏手柄“Xeno Pro”。与熟悉的依恋重逢

en.title: Check out the latest game pad "Xeno Pro" that has just been released at the LeadJoy booth. Reuniting with familiar attachments
en.summary: When I stopped by the LeadJoy booth at Tokyo Game Show 2026, they were exhibiting the latest game pad "XenoPro", which had just started sales. The highlight is that it is affordable at 9,980 yen (tax included) and has a wealth of functions.

items.title: 路面電車運転ゲーム「TRAMCITY HAKODATE」インプレッション。実機と同じスイッチ，そして電車の型番によって異なるアクセルレバーのノッチを再現する機構で，リアルな運転体験を演出する[TGS2026]
items.summary: 「東京ゲームショウ2026」にはさまざまなゲームが出展されているが，なかでもユニークだったのが，実機と同じ部品を使ったリアルな運転装置で路面電車を操縦する「TRAMCITYHAKODATE」のプレイ体験だ。そのプレイレポートをお届けしようクラウドファンディングが予定されている運転装置の仕様など，気になるところも聞いてみた。

zh.title: 电车驾驶游戏“TRAMCITY HAKODATE”的印象。使用与实际机器相同的开关和再现根据火车型号而不同的油门杆槽口的机构，产生真实的驾驶体验[TGS2026]
zh.summary: 在“2026年东京游戏展”上展出了各种各样的游戏，其中最独特的是“TRAMCITYHAKODATE”的游戏体验，您可以使用与真实机器使用相同部件的逼真驾驶装置来驾驶有轨电车。给大家带来游玩报告。我们还询问了计划众筹的驾驶设备的规格。

en.title: Impressions of the tram driving game "TRAMCITY HAKODATE". Produces a realistic driving experience with the same switch as the actual machine and a mechanism that reproduces the accelerator lever notch that differs depending on the model number of the train [TGS2026]
en.summary: A variety of games were exhibited at ``Tokyo Game Show 2026,'' but one that was unique was the play experience of ``TRAMCITYHAKODATE,'' in which you drive a streetcar using a realistic driving device that uses the same parts as the real machine. Let's bring you the play report. We also asked questions about the specifications of the driving equipment that is planned for crowdfunding.

items.title: 水没寸前の渋谷を漂う屋形船の寿司屋で，さまざまな来客にふさわしい一皿を振る舞う。ナラティブADV「SHIBUYA SUSHI MASTER」は日本風の「コーヒートーク」だった［TGS2026］
items.summary: TOONLEAGUEは，「東京ゲームショウ2026」に新作タイトル「SHIBUYASUSHIMASTER」を出展している。本作は2688年の水没寸前の渋谷を舞台に，寿司屋を営みながら客にふさわしい一皿を振る舞うナラティブADVだ。本稿では，試遊を通じて感じた本作のプレイフィールを紹介しよう。

zh.title: 涩谷漂浮的船屋上的寿司餐厅，濒临沉没，提供适合各种客人的菜肴。叙事ADV“SHIBUYA SUSHI MASTER”是日式“咖啡谈话”[TGS2026]
zh.summary: TOONLEAGUE 将在“2026 年东京游戏展”上展出新作《SHIBUYASUSHIMASTER》。本作是以2688年濒临淹没的涩谷为背景的叙事ADV，玩家经营着一家寿司店，为顾客提供完美的菜肴。在这篇文章中，我想介绍一下我通过试玩感受到的本作的玩法感受。

en.title: A sushi restaurant on a houseboat floating in Shibuya, on the verge of submersion, serves dishes suitable for a variety of guests. Narrative ADV “SHIBUYA SUSHI MASTER” was a Japanese-style “coffee talk” [TGS2026]
en.summary: TOONLEAGUE is exhibiting a new title "SHIBUYASUSHIMASTER" at "Tokyo Game Show 2026". This work is a narrative ADV set in Shibuya, which is on the verge of submersion in 2688, where the player runs a sushi restaurant and serves the perfect dish to his customers. In this article, I would like to introduce the play feel of this work that I felt through the trial play.

items.title: 「モンギル：STAR DIVE」，DMM GAMES版を11月中にリリース予定。開発PDのイ・ドンジョ氏が登壇したステージをレポート［TGS2026］

en.title: "Mongil: STAR DIVE", DMM GAMES version will be released in November. Report on the stage where development PD Lee Dong-jo took the stage [TGS2026]

items.title: コロプラのイベントは9月21日から9月20日に前倒しで実施。4Gamerブースの最新スケジュールを発表［TGS2026］
items.summary: 本日（2026年9月19日），CESAから発表があったとおり，台風25号の接近に伴い，東京ゲームショウ2026の最終日にあたる9月21日の開催中止が決定した。本決定により，4Gamerブースで同日に予定していたステージイベントも影響を受ける。最新のスケジュールをお伝えしよう。

zh.title: COLOPL活动将于9月21日至9月20日提前举行。公布4Gamer展位最新时间表[TGS2026]

en.title: The COLOPL event will be held in advance from September 21st to September 20th. Announcing the latest schedule of 4Gamer booth [TGS2026]

items.title: ゲームの腕を仕事に生かせる時代がやってくる？ コントローラで重機を遠隔操作する日特建設のデモを体験［TGS2026］

en.title: Will the era come when you can put your gaming skills to work? Experience Nittoku Construction's demonstration of remotely controlling heavy equipment using a controller [TGS2026]

zh.title: “我一定会拍《三国演义》第15部。”涩泽晃宣称。系列历代开发团队讲述《三国演义》系列40年历史及幕后制作的专题舞台报道【TGS2026】

en.title: “I will definitely make Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15,” Kou Shibusawa declared. Report on a special stage where successive development teams of the series talked about the 40-year history of the “Romance of the Three Kingdoms” series and behind-the-scenes production [TGS2026]

items.summary: 《剑星》与《猎天使魔女》的联动终于正式落地，同时，今天还公开了本次联动的第四套服装““Black Tresses””。而在本次TGS期间，机核也有幸采访到了《剑星》的制作人金亨泰先生。 <内嵌内容，请前往机核查看>身为《剑星》的创意总监，金亨泰表示，这次与《猎天使魔女》的合作并非一次临时起意的尝试。作为他个人非常喜爱的动作游戏之一，《猎天使魔女》在《剑星》的动作设计过程中也曾带来过直接的启发。随着《剑星》登陆NS2平台，Shift Up最终主动向白金工作室发出了合作邀请，也由此促成了这次联动。 在本次采访中，我们围绕这次合作的促成经过、两款作品在动作设计上的共通之处，以及双方在联动开发与监修过
